# mooncake agentd

Mooncake host daemon (run / install) (experimental)

## Description

Subcommands:
 run        — run the daemon (foreground; what systemd / launchd execs).
 bootstrap  — install agentd on this machine and print the bearer token.

## Subcommands

- [bootstrap](agentd_bootstrap.md) — Install agentd on this machine (no SSH detour)
- [run](agentd_run.md) — Run the agentd daemon in the foreground
